purpose: Durable full import-phase metrics for every predeclared observation, including controls, warmups and separate traces. Raw traces are retained in the linked artifact and identified by SHA-256.

manifest.timingBoundary: browser file-input change to post-UI completion; fresh profiles; no trace during timing
manifest.limitations: Six pairs on one Ubuntu host; sampled content equality, not exhaustive stored-row equality or memory qualification.

summary.interpretation: Screening evidence only; preserve controls and all tails. No cross-device or total-memory claim.

interpretationLimits: Ordinary measurements are the predetermined six adjacent pairs only; warmup, controls, and traces are excluded from effect estimates.
Phase details overlap and worker sums span parallel workers. Do not add them as independent wall-time contributions.
Chrome ProfileChunk samples belong to Profile by (pid, profile id); ProfileChunk tid is the sampler thread, not the sampled worker.
Self-stack sample intervals are elapsed sampling intervals, not CPU time. Blocking native calls, Atomics.wait, preemption, and profiler perturbation can dominate them.
RunTask tdur is per-thread CPU time; worker activities overlap in wall time.
maxWasmHeapBytes describes a single maximum parser heap, not whole-process or whole-browser peak memory.
Trace runs are diagnostic and not authoritative speed evidence.
